weekly_summaries.summary: Opened INTC/AMD/PLTR on Monday; stop-losses triggered on INTC (-4.94%) and AMD (-4.86%) Tuesday on market weakness. PLTR held. Re-entered AMD/INTC/PLTR at better prices but stopped out of INTC (-$1,214) and AMD (-$1,669) again. Net loss for week approximately -$3,000. Lesson: avoid chasing broad-market dip in volatile conditions; size positions smaller.

Opened AMAT, LLY, EOG. AMAT stopped out at $409.67 (-5.05%, -$1,656) on same-day sell-off; immediately re-entered at $411.45 on confirmed support. EOG benefited from Iran war oil tailwind (+30% since war started). LLY entered on retatrutide momentum; Mounjaro Q1 revenue +125% to $8.7B. Portfolio recovered to $99,068 by May 22 (+$963 on Friday). Holds: PLTR, AMAT (re-entry), LLY, EOG — all profitable by May 22.

Memorial Day Monday (market closed). Research: AI infrastructure super-cycle confirmed by NVDA blowout earnings ($81.6B +85% YoY), AMD data center surge (+38% revenue), MU HBM sold out through 2026. LLY retatrutide Phase 3 cleared (28.3% weight loss). Macro risk: PCE inflation Thursday (March was 3.5% headline, well above 2% target). Plan: CLOSE EOG (RSI 70.4 overbought, oil headwind, take 3.7% profit), HOLD AMAT/LLY/PLTR (each has 13-42% analyst upside). No new buys — stay at 3-position max and await post-PCE signal. NVDA post-earnings dip (#1 watchlist) and MU HBM (#2 watchlist) ready for next week if PCE benign.
